about_the_game:
Truth bends to spectacle, so make it spectacular.

Take the Stage

Play as a spell-slinging bard performing for your life. Compose rhythmic spell loops, defeat endless hordes, and keep the crowd entertained. When the applause stops, the curtain falls.

Compose Your Power

Build a six-slot spell sequence that casts automatically in rhythm. Rearrange your loop, combine elements, and discover explosive synergies that turn music into mayhem.

Applause Is Your Lifeline

The audience is your health bar. Earn cheers with combos and creativity, or face boos and rotten fruit when you falter. The show only ends when they stop clapping.

Dynamic Musical Chaos

Every spell changes the soundtrack. Each bard adds their own instruments and style, creating a unique performance that grows louder and wilder as your power builds.

Battle the Horde

Survive dynamic stages filled with shifting weather, theatrical lighting, and massive enemy waves. Bosses enter with flair and leave the stage in ruins.

Play Your Way

Unlock new bards, achievements, and talent trees. Experiment with builds, master your timing, and craft your ultimate composition.

Features

• Compose six-slot spell loops
• Chain elemental synergies
• Dynamic audience reactions
• Unlockable bards and talents
• Reactive, evolving soundtrack
• Pixel art with theatrical lighting

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu (e.g., 18.04, 20.04, 22.04)
  • Processor: Dual core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB VRAM (eg. R7 260X, GT 730)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu (e.g., 18.04, 20.04, 22.04)
  • Processor: Quad core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB VRAM (e.g. GT1030)
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
